test_endpoint.description:
From his first visit in 1975, he was immediately captivated by the vibrant life in the streets of Mexico. While his early black and white photos often feature stark, striking graphics, his foray into color photography starting in 1978—inspired by the light and color of the Mexican streets—marks a turning point in his work.

Throughout his work from Mexico, his rich compositions create compelling visual complexity—‘La Calle’ features strong, saturated colors, which evoke haunting, enigmatic scenes of the everyday. “I work extremely intuitively. I wander, I respond,” he says. “Am I aware of certain elements rationally at times? Sure. But I think that often when I am more aware of them, it usually means that the picture falls flat.”

Webb somehow manages to capture these surprising scenes, which add an otherworldly poetry to the genre of street photography.
test_endpoint.name: Nuevo Laredo, Mexico, 1996

test_endpoint.description:
A diptych artwork representing Hemera (left) by Flo & Nyx (right) by Blackenthered. A raffle of the physical diptych art will be done among collectors

The Seeing Light & the Watching Night

"In a tale woven with contrasting path, Hemera and Nyx, embodying the duality of night and day, forge an inseparable bond that transcends their differences, becoming pillars of unwavering support, bound by love and sacrifice, akin to the celestial harmony of the moon and the sun, the earth and the sky.

Their path is a continuous cycle of entering and leaving, but they'd visit each other twice a day, during dusk and dawn."


This piece is a very special collaboration, of twinsister Blackenthered and Flo, to celebrate their birthday. The twins have created two unique pieces of art that combine to form an incredible diptych. They each made each part separately, both are watercolor on paper; Flo painted Hemera and Blackenthered painted Nyx. They then combined the physical art as well as the digital version. This piece represents their uniqueness and differences as twinsisters nevertheless their bond and love are the strongest, that they are soulmate, despite being the day and the night.

It's watercolor on paper, with loads of pearlescent effect.
test_endpoint.name: The Seeing Light & the Watching Night

test_endpoint.description:
“Perspective” is a graphite pencil drawing created in prison. It is part of a unique collection of writings and 10 artworks by Ross Ulbricht, from early childhood to teen to prisoner. The collection also includes a 2m40s original animation by Levitate, created in collaboration with Ross. Once the auction is won, the entire collection will be compiled into one singular NFT using Kanon’s KSPEC protocol. 

Curated by Entoptic, this is the first and only NFT collection to include Ross Ulbricht’s personal work. 

Proceeds will fund efforts to relieve the suffering of the incarcerated and their families, as well as the fight to free Ross from a life in prison. 

Full list of what the collection includes at https://FreeRoss.org/genesis-collection

test_endpoint.description:
"For our May 10th / 17th 2021 issue, artist Mike Winkelmann (aka Beeple) wanted to take our readers inside his “canvas” to depict the stratospheric acceleration of the digitization of our world by creating an image that focused on his artistic process. The cover image depicts his actual computer interface mid design, complete with a wireframe render of a figure interacting on the left and a more complete version on right. He created this digital world using Cinema 4D and OctaneRender software that is powered by nearly a dozen Nvidia graphics cards." - D.W. Pine, Creative Director of TIME

“People have been creating digital artwork for the last 20 years and it has just as much craft, message, intent, as anything made on a canvas and has just as much ability to affect people emotionally and intellectually. It has been exciting through NFT’s to see people start to realize the value of this type of work and I think we’re just at the beginning of the next chapter of art history.” - Beeple
test_endpoint.name: TIME The Future of Business (Beeple Edition)
